name: scholaro
description: Convert transcripts to a US GPA with Scholaro and save GPA reports to your Scholaro account.

interface.shortDescription: Convert grades to a US GPA
interface.longDescription:
Scholaro converts international transcripts to a US GPA using Scholaro's grading scales, the same calculator as scholaro.com. Look up a country's grading scales, see how a scale works, calculate a GPA course by course, and save the result as a GPA report in your Scholaro account, where you can view, print or share it.

For Scholaro customers who use Scholaro's GPA tools, including staff of organizations that use Scholaro. Sign in with your existing Scholaro account; the plugin gives you the same access and limits as your account on scholaro.com.

Limitations: your Scholaro account needs access to Scholaro's GPA tools. Degree equivalency reports aren't available in the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Convert my Nigerian grades to a US GPA.
How does the German grading scale work?
Save my last GPA calculation as a Scholaro report.

positive.description: Calculate a GPA from a Nigerian transcript on a 5-point scale
positive.prompt: Convert these grades from Nigeria to a US GPA. The scale is 5-point. Mathematics 3 credits A, Physics 3 credits B, Chemistry 2 credits C, English 2 credits A.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each course with its US grade and grade points, and the overall US GPA calculated by Scholaro.

positive.description: Explain how a country's grading scale works
positive.prompt: How does the German grading scale work?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Germany's common grading scales and shows the grades on the chosen scale with their ranges and descriptions.

positive.description: Pick the right scale when a country has several
positive.prompt: Which grading scales does India use?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the grading scales Scholaro has for India, such as national, board and university scales.

positive.description: Save a calculated GPA as a report
positive.prompt: Save that GPA as a Scholaro report for Chidi Eze, University of Lagos.
positive.expected_behavior: After a calculation in the same chat, matches the institution and saves the GPA report to the account, returning a link to the report on scholaro.com. One report credit is used.

positive.prompt: Change Physics to an A and recalculate.
positive.expected_behavior: After a calculation in the same chat, recalculates the same transcript with the corrected grade and returns the updated US GPA.

negative.prompt: Delete all my saved Scholaro GPA reports.

negative.description: Changing the account password isn't supported

review.commerce_description: The plugin doesn't sell products or process payments. It uses the access the user already has on scholaro.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: GPA calculation, grading scale lookup and saving GPA reports for Scholaro Premium accounts.
